I replied to Marcus in #north-team, in the thread under his message. The main contact for Quarrendon Freight Lines is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations, and she is the one who flagged the door 6 duplicate arrivals in the August 2025 channel history.

The source is an undated internal cheat sheet, so the reply asks Marcus to check that the contact is still current. I also noted that Quarendon Freightways is a different company and not a Pemberline customer, to avoid mixing up the two names.
